cups_user.description: System user account under which the CUPS scheduler runs. Must have access to printer devices.

cups_group.description: System group for CUPS scheduler access to printer devices.

http_port.description: TCP port for HTTP printer access. Set to 0 to disable.

https_port.description: TCP port for HTTPS printer access. Set to 0 to disable.

max_clients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections.

max_jobs.description: Maximum number of completed/queued jobs to retain. Use 0 for unlimited.

max_job_size.description: Maximum job file size in bytes. 0 means unlimited.

timeout.description: Connection timeout in seconds before closing idle clients.

server_root.description: Base directory for CUPS configuration files (PPDs, policy files, etc.).

temp_dir.description: Directory used for temporary files during job processing.

web_interface.description: Enable or disable the web-based administration interface.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: debug, info, warn, error, critical.

log_dir.description: Directory where CUPS log files are stored.

system_group.description: Unix group whose members may manage CUPS (add/remove printers, etc.).

encryption.description: TLS policy: IfRequested, Always, Never, etc.

default_protocol.description: Default URI scheme for remote printer access (e.g., ipp, http, https).

remote_root.description: Allow or deny remote root login for print operations.

remote_admin_allow.description: List of IP addresses or CIDR ranges allowed to access remote administration.

remote_admin_deny.description: List of IP addresses or CIDR ranges explicitly denied remote admin access.

server_allow.description: List of hosts allowed to connect to the CUPS server.

server_deny.description: List of hosts explicitly denied access to the CUPS server.

remote_printers_allow.description: List of hosts allowed to discover and use remote printers (ipp://).

remote_printers_deny.description: List of hosts denied remote printer discovery.

auth_helper.description: Path to the authentication helper binary used for PAM/LDAP authentication.

enable_remote_admin.description: Enable remote administration via HTTP (requires RemoteAdminAllow).

enable_remote_printers.description: Enable remote printer sharing via ipp:// URIs.

server_name.description: Primary hostname used by the CUPS server for self-identification.

server_port.description: Port for server self-identification in URIs (usually same as http_port).

language_file.description: Path to the file listing supported BCP-47 languages.

job_private_access.description: Who may view job information: owner, all, none.

job_private_values.description: Job attributes to hide: none, all, or comma-separated list (e.g., job-name,job-originating-user-name).

printer_private_access.description: Who may view printer attributes: owner, all, none.

browsing.description: Enable printing service announcements (via DNS-SD or legacy CUPS broadcast).

browse_local_protocols.description: Protocols used to announce local printers.

browse_remote_protocols.description: Protocols used to discover remote printers.

default_shared.description: Newly added printers are shared by default.

page_logic.description: Enable legacy Page Logic (used by some vendor PPDs).

cache_dir.description: Directory for cached data (e.g., PPDs, font cache).

state_dir.description: Directory for persistent state (jobs, classes, etc.).

ppd_path.description: Directory for per-printer PPD files (not used in modern CUPS).

snmp_support.description: Enable SNMP-based printer discovery and monitoring.
